NARRATIVE AND PLANS
IN SUPPORT OF AN APPLICATION FOR A TYPE | MAP AMENDMENT
OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO ZONING MAP
FOR THE PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS 3005-17 WEST CARROLL AVENUE

Applicant seeks a Type | Map Amendment of the City of Chicago Zoning Map from the
current M1-2 District to that of a B2-5 District for the property commonly known as 3005-17
West Carroll Avenue. The site is improved with a multi-story formerly industrial building
whose total lot area is 22,455 square feet. Applicant seeks to use the existing building as
artist workshops and studios.

The following is a list of the existing bulk and density of the development:

Lot Area: 22,455 (existing)

Density: 0 residential dwelling units

Lot Area Per Unit: n/a

Off Street Parking: O spaces (existing)

Height: approximately 65 feet (existing)
Floor Area: 52,382 square feet (existing)
Floor Area Ratio: approximately 2.33 (existing)

Front (North) Setback: 0 feet (existing)

Rear (South) Setback: 0 feet (existing)*
East Side Setback: 0 feet (existing)*
West Side Setback: 0 feet (existing)*

*seeking 17-3-0405-B(2) Variation for reduced required rear yard and 17-3-0406 Variation for
reduced side setbacks
